notes:
- A message opens in the comment thread: Tapping a message, or the Message button on a friend, now opens that message's comment thread with the message itself as its first row, so every line - the message included - can be replied to and quoted. The bubbles-and-a-reply-box sheet is no longer reachable for a conversation that already has messages; it stays only for writing the first one.
- Holding the navigation bar goes nowhere: Holding the Profile tab and letting go opened your inbox, which made the gesture that starts a swipe also be a navigation on a press nobody completed. A hold now only lifts the bar; a tab changes when the finger drags to it.
- The GIF search types forwards: The search field rebuilt its text from the query on every keystroke, which put the caret at the start: typing cat searched tac, and the results were for a word the reader never wrote. The field keeps its own selection now, a new search opens at the top of its results, and the box has a clear button that goes back to your recent picks.
- A cancelled photo upload actually stops: Uploads ran as a blocking call that could not be interrupted, so closing the sheet mid-transfer kept the request and the file's bytes alive until the 150-second timeout, and could leave the composer stuck on Uploading. The transfer is cancellable now, and the flag clears however it ends.
- A quote keeps what it quoted: Quoting a comment flattened it: blank lines disappeared and a spoiler printed its own ~!...!~ tags. The quoted block is re-parsed from the comment, so the reply shows the same picture, spoiler or line breaks the reader chose to quote.
- A quote threads, and names its author once: Quoting somebody added the name twice and posted at the root of the thread instead of under the person it answered. A quote is now one credit line and one @mention, and it lands where the conversation was.
- Photos attach again while catbox is paused: catbox.moe stopped accepting anonymous uploads - its API answers every file with "Uploads paused until I can resolve storage issues" - so the attach button had nothing to attach to. The app still tries catbox first, then hands the same file to pomf.lain.la, and then to imgbb.com if that is down too. None of them needs an account, and Settings names all three as public hosts that cannot delete a file on request.
- The controls under a comment fit again: The heart, Reply, Quote, timestamp and manage dot were one scrolling line, so the control that edits or deletes your own comment could sit off the edge of a phone. They wrap onto a second line now, Reply and Quote are capsules you can see are buttons, and the like count moves to its new number instead of snapping.
- A message with no replies says why when it fails: A failed reply fetch under a message used to leave the message alone with no sentence and no retry, because the thread had a first row to draw and that path skipped the error. The banner and its Retry are drawn under the message now.
- New comments, reasons and notes arrive with motion: The "N new" pill springs in instead of appearing between frames, and the composer's limit, upload and post-error lines expand and collapse instead of re-laying the bar under the Post button in one frame.
